messages:
deploybot: ALERT: dedicated-eu1 pool failing canary healthchecks (p95 spike) at 2026-11-02T23:40:00Z. Auto-rollback blocked by release pin (compliance hold). Hotfix image ready: redwood/inference:2026-11-02-hotfix-kvttl. Requesting expedited unpin + 25m change window. @claire (release-lead) @harry (eng-lead) please ack.

claire: dropping in — can you paste short log snippet?

deploybot: probe: /generate p95=880ms (baseline 180ms). snippet: `WARN runtime.kv-cache: eviction storm -> increased heap churn; caller runtime/serve:handle_req`

harry: sounds like the TTL/eviction combo from yesterday's config flip. hotfix reverts that flip + increases min-ttl. tested in private staging with dedicated workload; 4 smoke runs green.

viv: infra check: dedicated nodes show memory transient growth at deploy but no disk pressure. no other scheduled jobs.

claire: need PM+compliance signoff to remove pin. @pm-beth? Also require deploybot guard rails: canary 3% for 10m, strict rollback p95>baseline*1.3 OR errors>0.4%, freeze other deploys.

pm-beth: legal/compliance ok for rollback revert. i'll update changelog and send note to two dedicated customers on EU1. image will be pinned in release notes.

ops-oncall: infra +1, but require freeze and manual handoff to oncall if threshold breached.

claire: ok i'm +approve (release lead, expedite). harry?

harry: +eng. queue deploybot with override and audit tag.

deploybot: command queued: `/deploy release --image redwood/inference:2026-11-02-hotfix-kvttl --scope canary --ramp 3% --observe 600s --auto-rollback-threshold "p95>+30% || errors>0.4%" --override-pin release-lead-claire --freeze-new-deploys --audit "dedicated-unpin-1102"`

claire: noted. pm-beth will send customer heads-up once canary is stable.

deploybot: 23:43 UTC - canary 3% started. reporting every 2m.

deploybot: 23:51 UTC - telemetry: p50/p95 = 48ms/195ms (baseline 45/180). errors 0.02%. within thresholds.

pm-beth: changelog updated https://go/release/2026-11-02-hotfix-kvttl. customers notified.

claire: okay to ramp to 30% over 5m.

ops-oncall: hold for one more 2m check then approve ramp.

deploybot: 23:55 UTC - check: p95=188ms, errors 0.01%. ops ok.

deploybot: 00:02 UTC - ramp to 30% complete.

claire: continue monitor, final ramp to 100% if stable at 00:10 UTC.

deploybot: 00:11 UTC - final: p95=170ms, errors 0.01%. ramping to 100% and removing pin. audit saved: dedicated-unpin-1102, run-id 20261102-bc9.

ops-oncall: unfreeze complete, resuming normal deploys. closing pager.

harry: follow-up action: schedule a dedicated-capacity stress test and add a gating test for eviction storms.

claire: thanks team. thread closed. :white_check_mark:
